verdict.rationale: The API reference mentions creating and driving Droid sessions including managing their "lifecycle, settings, and messages," implying that additional messages can be sent to an active session, and the interactive terminal UI (droid CLI) is inherently conversational, suggesting follow-up instructions are possible without restarting. However, there is no explicit documentation describing mid-task steering of an already-running agent or confirming it doesn't require a restart, and no hands-on/independent corroboration. missing for 10: explicit docs on sending follow-up messages to a running session, confirmation the agent incorporates new instructions without restart, independent/hands-on verification.
